description: This file defines the Debug formatter class for the SCSSPHP library, responsible for generating debug output of style blocks with indentation and detailed information.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: A deprecated debugger formatter class that extends Formatter to output detailed information about style blocks in a formatted, indented way.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Debug formatter with default indentation, separators, and other settings.

methods.name: indentStr
methods.description: Returns the current indentation string based on the indent level.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Outputs the lines of a style block for debugging.

methods.name: blockSelectors
methods.description: Outputs the selectors of a style block for debugging.

methods.name: blockChildren
methods.description: Recursively outputs the children of a style block.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Outputs the core information of a style block, including type and depth, and calls sub-methods for selectors, lines, and children.
